visual.general_description: Six light-microscopy panels (a) to (f) of one tissue section, one blue-violet stained and five brown chromogen stained, showing a large rounded cellular nodule.
visual.detailed_description: A 2 by 3 arrangement of low-power microscopy images of the same nodular tissue area, labelled (a) to (f) beneath each image. Panel (a) is blue-violet stained; panels (b) to (f) are brown chromogen immunostains that differ in strength and distribution: light brown (b), dark brown (c), weak and mostly peripheral (d), medium brown (e) and faint with sparse darker spots (f). No scale bars or other printed text.

panels.general_description: Low-power light microscopy of a blue-violet stained tissue section with a large rounded cellular nodule.
panels.detailed_description: A blue-violet to lilac stained section with pale pink and white areas. A large rounded or teardrop-shaped cellular nodule fills the left and centre, with two paler round zones in its lower part, separated by a pale pink-white band from a second darker cellular area at the right edge and a smaller one at the upper right. A small dark mark sits at the bottom edge. The label "(a)" is printed beneath. No scale bar or other text.

visual.general_description: Six light-microscopy panels (a) to (f): two pink-purple stained sections and four brown chromogen immunostained fields of dense small round cells.
visual.detailed_description: A 2 by 3 arrangement of microscopy images. The top row has a low-power pink-purple section (A), a high-power pink-purple field with scattered larger pale cells (B) and a brown immunostained field with membrane-like outlines (C). The bottom row has three brown immunostained fields (D, E, F) differing in the number of stained cells: sparse in D, dense in E and F.
